module.title: Remote Desktop Services checks
module.description: Checks for Remote Desktop Services: CAL licensing, session host load and the Connection Broker.
module.name: CheckRDS

commands.check_rds_licenses: Check Remote Desktop licensing (CAL key packs: issued versus available licenses).
commands.check_rds_sessions: Check session counts on a session host (active, inactive, total).
commands.check_rds_session_load: Check per-session resource usage (CPU, working set, protocol bytes).
commands.check_rds_broker: Check the Remote Desktop Connection Broker counterset (failed/pending connections).
